Jamiruddin Sirker with AHM Mushfiqur Rahman, Advocates----- For the Appellants.

Momena Khatun and others ----- Appellants
Vs.

full_judgment: 2. Appellants who are plaintiffs, stated ill the plaint, that RAJUK plot No. 12, Factory Road. Shyampur Kadamtali Industrial Area allotted to defendant No. 1, a private limited company under Companies Act vide memo dated 30-7-1985. or whom, Kazi Golam Hussain was the Chairman and other members of his family are directors includiIlg Kazi Zahir Hussain, who was the Managing Director, having in need of money the Board of Directors of defendant No. 1 on 3-10-1989 decided to sell suit property and expressed their desire to that effect, to which, AI-haj Mansur Rahman, predecessor of the plaintiffs agreed to purchase and price was settled at Taka 34,50,000. On 19-3-1990, plaintiffs paid Taka 18,50,000 through cheque, as earnest money in presence of witnesses. Consequently, a written agreement in respect of the suit property in favour of the predecessor of plaintiff on certain tenns and conditions was executed in bainapatra dated 19-3-1990 and thereafter, defendant No. 1 delivered physical possession of the suit plot to the plaintiffs. Defendant No. 1 wrote a letter to the Managing Director of Uttara Bank Ltd on 16-9-1990, in which admitted the agreement for sale dated 19-3-1990 and also admitted possession of the plaintiffs. Defendant No.1 due to financial problem, failed to pay installments to RAJUK, as such, some dispute arose between RAJUK and defendant No. 1 and defendant No. 1 requested the plaintiffs to take responsibility for payment of the entire installments to which the predecessor of the plaintiffs agreed and plaintiffs at first paid some installments in total Taka 19 lacks and Taka 14 lacks were remain unpaid. Plaintiffs also made payment to RAJUK the entire installments. The predecessor of the plaintiffs, thereafter requested the defendants to execute and register the sale deed, to which, defendant Nos. 2 to 4 and Kazi Golam Hussain executed a security bond on 18-3-1992 admitting the agreement for sale dated 19-3-1990. It is further plaint case that Kazi Golam Hossain, Chairman of defendant No. 1 and predecessor of defendant Nos. 2 to 4 handed over the original lease deed to the predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs in respect of the suit property with the assurance to execute and register the sale deed. Meanwhile Kazi Golam Hossain died leaving behind defendant Nos. 2 to 4 as his heirs, who are also directors of defendant No. 1 After he death Kazi Golam Hossain, the predecessor of the plaintiffs, AI- Haj Mansur Rahman requested the principal defendants to execute and register the sale deed to which at first they agreed but later on, step aside. In the meantime, on 20-11-1998, the predecessor of the plaintiffs died. Thereafter plaintiffs requested principal defendants to execute and register the sale deed but defendant Nos. 1 and 2 with the help or some local mastans and political touts, threatened to dispossess the plaintiffs and abused them with filthy language to which plaintiff No.2 made GD entry No. 259 dated 20-6-2000 with the Shyampur Police Station. On 21-12-2001 defendant No. 2 with the help of some local mastans, forcibly and illegally trespassed in to the suit premises and mercilessly beaten the care taker and darwan of the plaintiffs and took away valuable articles from their quarter and thereafter, left the place, for which, plaintiff No. 2 lodged an FIR with Shyampur police station and accordingly Shyampur PS Case No. 32(12) 2001 under section 323/448/143/427/380/506 of the penal Code was started and subsequently. charge sheet was submitted. Defendant No.2 also tiled a case under section 145 CrPC being Case No. 5877 or 2001 before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate over which, learned Chief Metropolitan Magistrate called report from Officer-in-Charge, Shyampur Police Station. Officer-in-Charge, Shyampur Police Stat ion submitted report. Thereafter, plaintiff applied to the Officer-in-Charge, Shyampur Police Station for posting 10 Ansars with fire arms and the application ultimately was allowed by the Commissioner or Metropolitan of Police vide memo dated 19-1-2002. Finally 10 Ansars along with fire arms were posted in the mill with a direction to the plaintiff No. 2 to bear their salary and ration vide memo No. 4127 dated 20-1-2002. Plaintiffs have been paying the same regularly. And thereafter when the defendants totally refused to execute and register the sale deed the suit was filed.
